name: automotive-quantum
description: Skill for applying quantum computing algorithms to simulate battery electrochemistry at the molecular level, covering variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) for molecular ground states, quantum phase estimation for reaction energetics, density functional theory acceleration, and hybrid classical-quantum workflows for battery material discovery. Covers 8 topics across quantum-computing domain. Includes 8 skill files covering ASTM E3076 - Standard Guide for ICME Verification and Validation, Battery500 Consortium Performance Targets, CVRP Benchmark Instances (Augerat, Christofides sets), ECE R94 - Frontal Impact Protection, ECE R95 - Side Impact Protection, EDIFACT DELFOR/DELJIT - Delivery Forecast and JIT Messages, ETSI QKD Standards (GS QKD 004, GS QKD 014), ETSI TS 103 097 - Security Headers and Certificates for ITS and more.
